## Additional VS Code Reference

For more information on VS Code, like how to set up tasks and create a color scheme, visit [this page](/reference/vscode__ref/).

## Checklist

1. Add `settings.json`.
1. Install color themes.
1. Add extensions.

## Settings

The `settings.json` file contains settings for VS Code and usually lives in the following locations:

OS      | Path
-|-
Unix    | `/home/<user-name>/.config/Code/User/settings.json`
Windows | `C:\\Users\<user-name>\\AppData\\Roaming\\Code\\User\\settings.json`

Access my `settings.json` and custom color theme below. If you need help with color theme installation, see  [this page](/reference/color-scheme__ref/vscode-color.qmd).

[settings.json](https://github.com/rebeccajennifer/setup-files/blob/main/vscode/settings.json){class="flux-button _3"}
[Original Color Themes](https://github.com/rebeccajennifer/setup-files/tree/main/vscode/rebecca-jennifer.flux-bunny-themes){class="flux-button _3"}

### Settings Override

The `settings.json` file located at the user level will take precedence.
To override or add to the settings at the workspace or directory level,
create a new directory called `.vscode` and add another `settings.json`
file here.

### Vim

Point Vim extension to local `.vimrc` file.

### Code Runner Configuration

- Enable `Clear Previous Output`
- Disable `Show Execution Message`
